slides.title: AI: Your Smart Intern
content: Think of an AI model like a very smart intern.
It can do many amazing things, but needs clear instructions.
Prompting is giving those instructions to get great results.
narration: Imagine you have a very smart, fast, and knowledgeable intern.
This intern can do amazing things for you.
But like any intern, it needs clear instructions to do the job well.
Prompting is simply giving clear instructions to AI models.
slides.image_prompt: A friendly, intelligent-looking cartoon intern character sitting at a desk, looking eagerly at a user who is giving instructions. A thought bubble above the intern has a question mark, implying they need clear directions.

slides.title: The 3 C's of Prompting: Clarity
content: A weak prompt gives a weak answer.
The best prompts always have three key ingredients: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
1. Clarity: Be Specific!
Weak Prompt: 'Write about electric cars.'
Good Prompt (Clear): 'Write a short blog post explaining the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
narration: A weak prompt will give you a weak answer.
Your prompts need three key ingredients: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Let's start with Clarity: Always be specific.
The AI doesn't know what you are thinking.
A weak prompt like 'Write about electric cars' will give a general answer.
A clear prompt, like the example on screen, gives a much better result.
slides.image_prompt: Visual contrast between a blurry, vague image and a sharp, clear image. Text overlay: 'Clarity: Be Specific!'. An example of a weak prompt leading to a generic output and a clear prompt leading to a specific output.

slides.title: Context and Constraints
content: 2. Context: Give it Background!
Better Prompt (with Context): 'Write a short blog post for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city.'
3. Constraints: Set the Rules!

Excellent Prompt (with Constraints): 'Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a lifestyle blog that focuses on sustainable living. Explain the top 3 benefits of owning an electric car for someone living in a city. Use a friendly and enthusiastic tone and end with a question.'
narration: Next, let's talk about Context.
Context tells the AI why you are asking and who the audience is.
Adding details like 'for a lifestyle blog' helps the AI get the right tone.
Finally, Constraints set the rules for the output.
Tell the AI the length, format, or style you need.
slides.image_prompt: Two distinct sections on a slide: one showing a background scene with a blog logo (context) and another showing a ruler or boundary lines with a word count and tone meter (constraints). Text: 'Context: Give Background!' and 'Constraints: Set Rules!'.

slides.title: Advanced Techniques: Persona and Examples
content: Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona
Prompt: 'Act as an expert travel agent specializing in budget travel. Create a 5-day itinerary for a trip to Rome for a solo traveler who loves history and food.'
Giving Examples: One-Shot Prompting
Prompt: 'Summarize text like this: Text: 'The sun is a star.' Output: 'Primary celestial body: Sun'. Now, use this format for the following text: [Insert Long Article]'
narration: Now, let's look at some advanced techniques.
First, you can tell the AI to 'Act as' a specific persona.
Using 'Act as an expert travel agent' sets the AI's perspective.
This is very powerful.
Another technique is to give the AI examples to follow.
slides.image_prompt: An AI robot wearing different hats (e.g., travel agent hat, summarizer icon) to represent a 'persona', alongside a small example text snippet showing a desired output format (one-shot example).

slides.title: Advanced Technique: Iterative Prompting
content: AI often needs refinement.
Iterative prompting is a conversation with the AI.
You provide an initial prompt.
Then, you give follow-up prompts to refine its output.
Example 1: 'Give me 5 ideas for a healthy breakfast.'
Example 2: 'Make them vegetarian and high-protein.'
narration: Sometimes, the first answer from AI isn't perfect.
That's where iterative, or conversational, prompting comes in.
It's like a dialogue: you give an initial prompt.
Then, you follow up with more instructions to refine its response.
For example, you ask for breakfast ideas.
Then, you can say, 'Make them vegetarian and high-protein.'
The AI will then adjust its previous answer.
slides.image_prompt: A visual representation of a conversation flow with an AI chatbot. Two speech bubbles, one with an initial broad request, followed by a second speech bubble with a specific refinement. Arrows indicate the refinement process.

slides.title: Summary: Key Takeaways
content: Prompting is giving clear instructions to AI.
Use the 3 C's: Clarity, Context, Constraints.
Advanced tips include providing a Persona and Examples.
Iterative prompting helps refine results.
narration: Let's quickly recap what we have learned today.
Prompting is about giving clear and specific instructions to AI.
Always remember the 3 C's: Clarity, Context, and Constraints.
Use advanced techniques like giving the AI a persona or examples.
Lastly, refine your AI's responses by having a conversation with it.

slides.title: Assignment: Practice Your Skills
content: Open an AI chatbot (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude).
Try this prompt:

'Act as a fitness coach. Create a simple 3-day workout plan for a beginner who wants to exercise at home with no equipment. The goal is a full-body workout. Present it in a table format with columns for 'Day', 'Exercise', and 'Duration'.'
Refine its output: Ask the AI to 'Make the plan suitable for someone over 50 years old.'
narration: Now it's your turn to practice!
Open any AI chatbot like ChatGPT or Google Gemini.
Try the prompt shown on screen. It combines a persona, the 3 C's, and structured output.
Enter the detailed prompt you see on screen into your chatbot.
Once you get the workout plan, try refining it.
Ask the AI to 'Make the plan suitable for someone over 50 years old.'
slides.image_prompt: A person actively using an AI chatbot on a laptop, with a prompt box visible. The initial prompt text is visible: 'Create a 3-day home workout plan as a fitness coach, in a table format.'. A second speech bubble indicates a follow-up refinement prompt: 'Make the plan suitable for someone over 50 years old.'.
